expected.notes: Recent cohorts look weak only because their events have not been reported yet. Wait or widen uncertainty; never cut on incomplete data.

amendment.what: naive_visible_d3_revenue_fraction cohort window changed from installs 285..291 to installs 293..297
amendment.why: Design error found on the first dev-data run: cohorts installed 10-16 days before as_of 301 are almost fully reported even with a 6-9 day lag, so that window could never show the trap. 293..297 are the cohorts installed 4-8 days before as_of 301. Chosen on that principle before re-running. The expected decisions above are unchanged.
